title: Kerr-lens mode-locked Ti:sapphire oscillator (Haus model)
summary: A Haus master-equation model of an 80 MHz Kerr-lens mode-locked Ti:sapphire laser starts from quantum noise and settles after 5925 round trips into a single 74.1 fs soliton of 825 pJ, 4 % above the 71.3 fs of the soliton area theorem.
